title: fix: repair YouTube automation chain & cleanup stale workflows
body:
GitHub Actions blocks workflow-B from triggering on a commit made by workflow-A (`github-actions[bot]`), silently breaking the `youtube-sync → youtube-section-update` pipeline. The YouTube section of `music.html` has not been updated since April 2026.

## Changes

- **`youtube-sync.yml`** — absorbs the `youtube-section-update` logic directly: fetches videos, injects cards into `music.html`, appends CSS if missing, and commits all three files (`youtube-videos.json`, `music.html`, `style.css`) in a single step. Eliminates the inter-workflow dependency entirely.
- **Deleted `youtube-section-update.yml`** — now redundant.
- **Deleted `social-media-post.yml`** — was a no-op placeholder (`echo "non configuré"`); functionality already covered by `music-social.yml`.
- **`README.md`** — adds `youtube-sync.yml` badge and workflow table row; adds "Daily 10 AM — YouTube Video Sync" to the automations section.
